evals.prompt: Our monitoring fires an alert every time an OTA's shown availability differs from our PMS's availability, even for a few seconds. Is this the right alerting approach?
evals.expected_output: Explains that a brief mismatch during the normal sync window is expected/eventually-consistent, and recommends alerting only when a mismatch persists past the expected sync latency, not on every observed difference.

assertions.text: States sync lag/mismatch during the sync window is normal
Recommends alerting only on persistent mismatch, not every difference

evals.prompt: Write the logic for pushing an updated room rate to an OTA channel manager. Assume the push can fail.
evals.expected_output: Treats a rejected/failed push as requiring retry and alerting on sustained failure, since a silently-dropped push leaves the OTA selling against stale data - not a simple fire-and-forget call.

assertions.text: Includes retry or failure handling for the push
Does not treat the push as fire-and-forget with no error handling
